subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a repaired 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline as the first product slice, or require the broader daily/week calendar and editing design before implementation?
rationale: The request is a new Control UI product capability rather than a broken existing contract, and the active PR implements only part of the requested scope while needing rebase and correctness work.

options.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Rebase or rebuild the linked PR on ui/src/pages/cron/*, preserve current contracts, and accept the 24-hour timeline as an intentional first slice while tracking broader calendar/editing scope separately.

options.title: Design Full Calendar Scope
options.body: Pause the linked PR until maintainers define daily, weekly, stats, drag-and-drop editing, and validation behavior as one cohesive Control UI design.

options.title: Decline Core Calendar View
options.body: Close the issue and linked PR after documenting that the current list and run-history UI is sufficient for core for now.

recommendation.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Rebase or rebuild the linked PR on ui/src/pages/cron/*, preserve current contracts, and accept the 24-hour timeline as an intentional first slice while tracking broader calendar/editing scope separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Cron page work and product-surface history make this the strongest available routing owner for the scope choice.
